items.title: Eddie Palmieri — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Mr. Levy calls me in. “Mr. Palmieri, what did you record for me THIS time?”

ctx.x: You’re talking about the political group.

Yeah. I was their favorite artist. They caught all these guys with my record, and then here comes the FBI again, to Morris Levy again, and the CIA. Mr. Levy calls me in. “Mr. Palmieri, what did you record for me THIS time?” [LAUGHS] So you see what I mean?
But this is a significant album. Like you mentioned, you were doing crossover. So now you’re not just blending Caribbean music...
